curriculum.name: close_open_emails_to
curriculum.goal: Given a person, close all still-open emails addressed to that person and return those emails.
curriculum.gold:
PROCEDURE close_open_emails_to(person:PERSON)
$v0 = FIND EMAIL WHERE SELF.RECIPIENT={person} STATUS=OPEN
FOR $v1 IN $v0 : SET_STATUS $v1 CLOSED
RETURN $v0
END
